Variants.Content: Visgradka (Sarys) is located in the old land of Sarnor on the northern edge of the Dothraki Sea. Politically, it is within the area where Sarnor's remnants, steppe tribes and remaining towns intersect. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

The craftsmen of Visgradka left behind their craftsmanship through workshops, markets, roof tiles, church bells, and the streets that expanded over the ages, while the priests explained life and death with the memory of the past high kings, the ruined city, and the gods swallowed up by the sea of ​​grass. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

When people from afar see the coat of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
